description.la: Sermones de diversis, CXXV, in editione Mabillonii.
description.en-US: Bernard’s 125 sermons on various subjects as Mabillon edited them: on the fleetingness of life, the knowledge of oneself, the virtues and vices, the gifts of the Spirit and the stages of the soul’s ascent. The Latin is the Maurist text in Migne (Patrologia Latina 183, 1854). Latin only, from the Maurist text in Migne, a machine-corrected OCR.
description.pt-BR: Os 125 sermões de Bernardo sobre assuntos diversos, na edição de Mabillon: a brevidade da vida, o conhecimento de si, as virtudes e os vícios, os dons do Espírito e os graus da ascensão da alma.

la.editor: Jean Mabillon, in J.-P. Migne (Patrologia Latina 183)

sources.edition: S. Bernardi Claraevallensis abbatis opera omnia, ed. J. Mabillon, in Migne, Patrologia Latina 183 (Paris 1854); TEI XML of the Corpus Corporum (University of Zurich), work 6216, from machine-corrected OCR.
sources.description: The complete text with Mabillon’s admonitio, chapter headings and summaries. PL page breaks and column numbers are dropped, and so are the paragraph numbers; Scripture references stay in parentheses as printed.
sources.tierEvidence: Bernard died in 1153; Migne’s printing is public domain everywhere.
